guard: help, the entry screen and a failure written to a real terminal fit its width: lines wrap at spaces with each continuation under its text, a usage breaks only between options, and a flag column too wide for its descriptions puts each description under its flag
why: Only a real terminal reports a width, so only the pty suite can show help and failures read it. The binary imports the CLI and workspace packages through their builds, so each mutation rebuilds the package it changes and the restore rebuilds it back.

mutations.name: help keeps a description beside a flag column that leaves it fewer than 30 columns
mutations.expectRed: on 60 columns a flag description goes under its flag
mutations.cell: on 60 columns a flag description goes under its flag

mutations.name: help leaves its usage to the report renderer's wrap
mutations.expectRed: on 60 columns its usage wraps only between options
mutations.cell: on 60 columns its usage wraps only between options

mutations.name: a usage group too wide for its line is left to the report renderer's wrap
mutations.expectRed: on 60 columns cotal help send breaks its destination group after its alternatives
mutations.cell: on 60 columns cotal help send breaks its destination group after its alternatives

mutations.name: a usage breaks between options before its own alternatives
mutations.find: const cuts = level.some((gap) => gap.alternative) ? level.filter((gap) => gap.alternative) : level;
mutations.expectRed: on 40 columns cotal help setup breaks a nested group after its own alternative
mutations.cell: on 40 columns cotal help setup breaks a nested group after its own alternative

mutations.name: a usage word may leave its argument
mutations.expectRed: on 40 columns cotal help completion script keeps script with its argument
mutations.cell: on 40 columns cotal help completion script keeps script with its argument

mutations.name: a compact | is not a break point
mutations.expectRed: on 40 columns cotal help persona breaks a compact group after its own |
mutations.cell: on 40 columns cotal help persona breaks a compact group after its own |

mutations.name: help --all writes its title unwrapped
mutations.expectRed: on 40 columns cotal help --all wraps its title
mutations.cell: on 40 columns cotal help --all wraps its title

mutations.name: the entry screen ignores the terminal's width
mutations.expectRed: cotal help on a 60-column terminal fits every line
mutations.cell: cotal help on a 60-column terminal fits every line

mutations.name: help ignores the terminal's width
mutations.expectRed: cotal help spawn on a 80-column terminal fits every line
mutations.cell: cotal help spawn on a 80-column terminal fits every line

mutations.find: else out.push(...block.lines.flatMap((line) => drawWrapped(line, style, width - indent.length).map((shown) => indent + shown)));
mutations.expectRed: a failure on a 40-column terminal wraps under its text
